dataList.content:
Dammit, they just won’t stop coming!
妈的，这帮人别再蹦出来了！

Keep this up and we'll be dead knackered before we even set foot in that bloody casino!
我们在抵达赌场之前就要累死了。

Don’t fret, Heathcliff. As long as the manager is with us, there’s no chance we’ll die from fatigue—
请放心，希斯克利夫。只要经理在，我们就不会累死的……

You think I don’t KNOW that, you %#@&**?!
那种事情谁都知道！#@$@#$！！！

The solution is simple: Any organization can be brought down by killing its leader. Smash the head in, and the sack of meat propping it up will also collapse.
解决方法很简单。不论何种帮派，只要消灭头目，
支撑其的血肉也会分崩离析。

Now that's what I like to hear. You're the only one makin' sense out of this lot.
你，是这里唯一一个说出我心里话的。

I’m proper miffed, so let’s go break something—bones, heads, whatever.
我快烦死了，管他什么头啊血啊肉啊，全打烂不就好了。

Come, then! Onward we travail!
来吧，就此前进！

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Wait! Get back here, all of you!
等等！都给我回来！

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content: ... This is the crowd you’re supposed to accompany, Faust? ……浮士德，你必须得和这群菜鸟们一起行动吗？

Life is full of mysteries.
人生总是充满疑问。

That, perhaps, is what makes it an ideal reflection, no?
也可以说那很理想。

Tell me where your gaffer is! I wanna see ‘im, now!
你们的老大在哪！让他马上滚出来！

Heathcliff seized a Tingtanger by the collar and shook him about violently, even as it seemed the man's last shred of consciousness was quickly leaving him...
希斯克利夫揪着一个已经失去意识的混混的衣领用力摇晃。

... possibly to never return.
……也许不仅仅是失去了意识。

dataList.title:
Tingtang Gang
豆豆帮
dataList.teller:
Chest-puffing Tingtanger
想表现得很强壮的豆豆帮成员
dataList.content:
The sea heart… should be at the car pagoda…
我们的大哥……在汽车塔那里……
The what? Where the hell is that?! Start making sense, or else...! 汽车塔？汽车塔在哪？！说清楚点！

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
He probably means the scrapyard nearby.
大概是附近的那个废车场吧。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
But seriously—are you actually planning to take out Tingtang's Boss?
话说回来，你们真的要干掉豆豆帮的帮主吗？

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
You do realize that won't earn you anything on your employee performance review, right?
而且那可不会算在你们的人事考核里啊。明白了吗？

He’s not sharp enough to factor in such things before he acts.
那个人可没有把那种事情考虑到行动中去的脑子。

Indeed. He is also a pile of refuse, far removed from schemes or forethought—and quite acquainted with absurdities.
他就是个与计谋和方案毫不相干的废物。反倒是和荒唐的事情有关。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Actually… His plan might be a valid alternative.
不……我觉得那也许并不荒唐。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Nothing to worry about, Effie. We always keep a Plan B, don’t we?
没问题的，埃菲。我们不总是准备好了计划B吗？

Saude said with a gentle smile on her face.
索德一脸温和地继续说道。

Though Saude spoke calmly, I caught the faint cracks beneath the veneer of composure—like she was making a huge effort just to hold herself together.
但是，我不时能注意到她在刻意保持平静，这让我觉得她温和的外表或许只是演出来的罢了。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
If disguising yourselves as your given roles is no longer an option...
既然各位的伪装已经没戏了……

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
Then you can pose as members of the Tingtang Gang instead.
那你们可以直接扮成豆豆帮成员上去。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
That way, you won't draw much suspicion even if you move together as a group. You should be able to reach the top floor without much trouble, too.
这样就算是抱团行动也不会引人注目，而且还能很简单地潜入顶楼。

dataList.title: LCCB
dataList.content:
And while we're at it, maybe we can siphon a bit of wishpower from the Tingtang Gang as well.
我们顺便还能夺走豆豆帮的愿力。
